title: Yunfu Intelligent Raises ¥10M Series A from Yushi Capital for AICC + Digital Humans
summary: On Apr 15, 2023, voice big-data / intelligent contact-center vendor Yunfu Intelligent / Nanjing Xingfu Tech raised ¥10M Series A from Yushi Capital (御势资本). Proceeds: accelerate self-developed CHATBOT × ChatGPT, digital-human R&D/deploy, compute + algorithms, commercialize
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Company / funding · May 15, 2023

On Apr 15, 2023, voice big-data / intelligent contact-center vendor Yunfu Intelligent / Nanjing Xingfu Tech raised ¥10M Series A from Yushi Capital (御势资本). Proceeds: accelerate self-developed CHATBOT × ChatGPT, digital-human R&D/deploy, compute + algorithms, commercialize digital human & AICC.

Founded 2018 — early China AI voice dialer; ~1–2× annual growth; small-B focus with CRM + AICC integrated. Self-built AICC: AI outbound, human–AI collab, live agent — customer portrait, smart service, interactive call/survey/notice + CRM BI middle platform. Team from Alibaba / Suning / iFlytek; NLP stack (reading comprehension, semantics, multi-turn, QA, KG). CEO Wei Jiaxing: early-2023 ChatGPT outbound demos. Angel (Aug 2019) from Lu Qi (YC China). Clients: property, auto, renovation, finance, internet, education, ecommerce, enterprise services.

Notes semantic-parse as core of next-gen search / digital humans; current datasets small/template-heavy; only low-complexity intents (weather, alarms) land well — NLP still needs vertical sink.

— END —
